rationale: A wins because it separates investor-margin, borrower-accountability, operator-feature, payroll-labor, and category stories without pretending they are the same pitch. Its strongest line, "Toast wants to be its restaurants' bank. It won't say how many of them default," gives a real reporter conflict and a proof burden. B has useful bones, but "Toast crosses 120,000 restaurant locations as it pivots from hardware to fintech margins" mashes milestone, category, and margin thesis into one overstuffed handle, then throws away the payroll story as a duplicate. That is not discipline; that is leaving a beat on the floor.
gaps_in_A: "Toast wants to be its restaurants' bank" and "the operating account" push the bank metaphor past the supplied facts. Lending and payroll are not deposits, accounts, or banking unless Toast can prove the strategy that way.

"profitability arrived alongside a stated shift" implies timing and causality the fact block does not fully prove. It needs the filing or earnings sequence before anyone says the margin story explains profit.
"tip distribution, shifting hours, and high turnover" makes the payroll angle sharper, but only tipped/hourly staff were supplied. Keep those as reporting hypotheses, not established facts.
gaps_in_B: "The prevailing belief is that a newly profitable, publicly traded platform lending against its own customers' sales has a clean, well-understood book" invents a market belief. A contrarian angle needs a real belief to puncture, not one summoned for drama.

"Toast payroll solves the tipped-vs-hourly staffing headache... duplicate of the customer-story angle's protagonist" is a bad refusal. Payroll is a labor and operations story, not the same beat as restaurant borrowing.

"pivots from hardware to fintech margins" and "fintech wearing restaurant clothing" overstate the update. The facts say Toast is bundling products and says fintech is higher-margin; they do not prove a full identity pivot.
"Next step: newsjack-detector" is the wrong move. The update already has a why-now; the missing work is proof, owner access, and journalist fit, not hunting for another peg.
